value.rationale: The observable is natural global state purity accessible by two-copy methods, and reset probability provides a tunable physical knob. Exact finite-sample recovery of the positive occupied gap measure gives useful spectroscopy information absent full state tomography, while the explicit homometric pair sharply shows its intrinsic limitation. Value is in identifiability, not routine computation or claims of robust noisy experiments.
